description: This file defines the class ImportDuplicateCheck, which handles duplicate record detection by comparing specific fields and indexes for bean objects within the SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods for retrieving index definitions, checking for duplicates based on fields and indexes, and managing related data structures.

classes.name: ImportDuplicateCheck
classes.description: A class responsible for detecting duplicate records within the SuiteCRM system by comparing specific fields and indexes for a given bean object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ImportDuplicateCheck with a bean object to be checked for duplicates.

methods.name: _getIndexVardefs
methods.description: Retrieves index definitions for the bean, including custom indexes and special email indexes.

methods.name: getDuplicateCheckIndexes
methods.description: Returns a list of index labels used for duplicate checking, with labels localized to the current language.

methods.name: isADuplicateRecordByFields
methods.description: Checks if the current bean is a duplicate based on provided fields, including email and other indexed fields.

methods.name: isADuplicateRecord
methods.description: Checks if the current bean matches existing records based on index definitions, considering special cases like full name and email.

methods.name: getDuplicateCheckIndexedFiles
methods.description: Provides an array of index fields suitable for exporting and duplicate checking, considering module-specific exclusions and field translations.
